method: Native search filter on employee_growth_3mo (ratio; 1.03 = +3% over 3 months). Used because enrichment read-back (get-task-context) returned 'Internal error' on every attempt. Searches return the matching set only, not the ratio itself, so the result is a band, not a number.
base_filter: domain in (34 cohort domains) and company_size = '10,001+'

satellite_noise: JHU Office of Diversity and Inclusion (6)

note: Satellite pages carry the '10,001+' size band of their parent with tiny headcounts, so a growth filter on a parent domain returns them too. Only entities in divisions.csv count. Everything not in either band is 'flat_or_unreported' (between -3% and +3%, or no ratio) - not 'flat'.
